headline: Central bank holds rates steady amid slowing growth
body: The central bank announced on Tuesday that it would keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged, citing a slowdown in manufacturing output and softer consumer demand across the region.

headline: Tech shares slide as earnings disappoint
body: Technology stocks fell sharply in early trading after several large firms reported quarterly results below analyst expectations, with guidance cut for the coming year.

headline: Airline reports record quarterly profit
body: The carrier said net income rose by a fifth, driven by strong demand for international travel and lower fuel costs across its network.

headline: Retailer warns on margins
body: The retailer cut its full-year margin forecast, citing higher freight costs and heavier discounting in its home market.
